_note: Available Computer Opponents table. policy per brief mapping; targetPriority only for Cyborg (order per manual L285-L286: weakened, winning, attacked them in the past). aimNoiseHint = one-line reading of what noise the tier should inject; foreman will tune.
_aiSource: ai (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012, plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 foreman tuning): per-tier decision-core knobs consumed by src/gameplay/ai.js + systems/ai_turn.js — angleErrorDeg/powerError are the seeded-noise bounds (aimNoiseHint transcribed to numbers), thinkDelayFrames paces the turn (sim frames), driveAffinity 0..1 scales per-turn driving, heavyCloserId/heavyRange/farWeaponId are the weapon prefs (heavy closer, lobber at range) constrained by affordability + arms level.
_aiTiers: Per manual:L251-L292 mapping: moron full-range noise (30deg/0.35 power), shooter ~1-2deg jitter, poolshark as shooter, tosser large shrinking error (static large band, _placeholder per-shot refinement), chooser/spoiler near-zero, cyborg as spoiler, unknown mid-band.

personalities.name: Moron
personalities.description: Picks an angle and power at random and shoots; for beginners only.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Full-range uniform noise: angle and power drawn uniformly from all legal values, no feedback.

personalities.name: Shooter
personalities.description: Deadly only with a straight line of fire to the target.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Near-exact bearing toward target when visible; small angle jitter (~1-2 deg) so repeated shots do not stack.

personalities.name: Poolshark
personalities.description: Like a Shooter, but with rebounding walls tries bank shots off walls and ceilings.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Straight-line jitter as Shooter, plus occasional wall-bank solution pick with mirrored-angle tolerance when wallMode is RUBBER/SPRING.

personalities.name: Tosser
personalities.description: Starts like a Moron, then refines aim shot by shot until it hits.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Large initial error (e.g. +-20 deg / big power band) shrinking geometrically with each miss based on impact offset.

personalities.name: Chooser
personalities.description: Has all previous methods available and picks the most effective one.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: No own noise: inherits the noise profile of the method chosen per turn (moron/shooter/poolshark/tosser).

personalities.name: Spoiler
personalities.description: Accounts for wind and gravity for a near-perfect shot; cannot compensate for viscous air.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Near-zero noise analytic solution incl. wind; residual error grows when airViscosity > 0 (never models drag).

personalities.name: Cyborg
personalities.description: Spoiler-like aim, but nastier target choice: prefers weakened tanks, winners, and tanks that attacked it.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Spoiler noise profile (near-zero, wind-aware); noise only used to spread fire when several equal-priority targets tie.

personalities.name: Unknown
personalities.description: One of the above personalities is chosen at random to control the tank, secretly.
personalities.aimNoiseHint: Uniformly pick one of the 7 tiers at game start and adopt its noise silently for the whole game.
